messages:
sasha: Heads-up: the Localization & Availability page still shows examples that assume hosted endpoints only. Spotted two issues: the Python SDK example sets region='eu-west-1' (no longer recommended for private installs) and the availability matrix lacks the CA residency caveat for on-prem deployments. Filing a PR.

anita: good catch. can you paste the python snippet? i'll start a short migration blurb.

sasha: current snippet: 

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), region='eu-west-1')
```

proposed for private: 

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), endpoint='https://console.private.myorg.redwood')
```

also suggesting we add a small table note: "Private deployments: endpoint must be used; residency is customer-controlled; see legal note (CA)."

omar: i can add the CA footnote wording. pinging legal-bot to confirm the exact phrasing for Canadian on-prem residency. we should be careful not to conflate region availability with deployment mode.

legal-bot: Legal notified: issue-1257 opened to review CA residency footnote. Draft language suggestion: "In Private/on‑prem deployments, data residency is determined by the customer's infrastructure and contract. Redwood does not assume residency for Private installations; consult your contract team." Please confirm if this wording works for docs.

anita: that wording is clear. i'll add it as footnote 4 in the matrix and include a short inline callout near the top: "Note: Hosted/Dedicated residency guarantees differ from Private deployments."

omar: one more thing: our curl + CLI examples default to api.redwood.ai — add a $PRIVATE_API_HOST example and show using Host header override for older clients. small snippet i propose: 

```bash
PRIVATE_HOST=https://console.private.myorg.redwood
curl -X POST "$PRIVATE_HOST/v1/completions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"hi"}'
```

sasha: perfect. can docs-bot create a draft PR with the python + curl changes, matrix footnote update, and a short migration note mapping region -> endpoint? tag @omar and @anita.

docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5499 4 files changed (matrix, python snippet, curl examples, migration-note) 4 assigned: @omar @anita. (automated)

anita: i'll pick up the migration note and add a changelog bullet under the "SDK snippets" section: "SDKs: prefer 'endpoint' for Private deployments; 'region' remains supported for Hosted/Dedicated but will map to endpoint in future releases."

omar: i'll wait for legal issue-1257 before merging the footnote, but we can ship the code snippets first with a TODO comment and link to the legal issue. i'll also run a quick repo grep for "region='" and "region:" and open follow-ups if found.

sasha: timeline: aim to merge snippets today, footnote when legal clears. thanks all.
